title: Paging through ZIA lists with the Python SDK

prose.text: Python SDK lists come back one page at a time, so a single call is not the whole collection. The Go equivalents are [[shared.sdk-go.list-pagination]], and the URL Filtering specifics are in [[zia.url-filtering.list-pagination]].

prose.label: History.
prose.text: {{pagination-fix-history}} Whether the user and group lists still lose a record is open {{gap:n-minus-1-regression}}.

checks.do: Whether the caller loops on has_next and stops cleanly, instead of assuming the first call returned the whole collection.
Whether the total matches a count the tenant knows (console count, expected size) after a bulk read, given the SDK's pagination fix history.

first-page-only.statement: A Python SDK list method that supports pagination returns only the first page of results initially.

quotes: only the first page of results is returned initially.

has-next-next.statement: The response object carries has_next and next methods to fetch the following pages.

quotes: You can then use the `response.has_next()` and `response.next()` methods to retrieve subsequent pages.

stopiteration-at-end.statement: Calling next when there is no further page raises StopIteration rather than returning an error value.

quotes: The SDK raises a StopIteration if `next()` is called and no more pages are available

stops-on-short-page.statement: The README says paging stops when fewer results than the page size are returned; in code this applies only when the caller supplied a page size, otherwise it stops on an empty page.

quotes: Pagination stops automatically when fewer results than the page size are returned
Improved pagination termination logic to stop when partial pages are returned

zia-default-page-size.statement: Since release 1.8.4 the SDK no longer forces a default page size and uses each API's native default, which the changelog gives as 100 for ZIA.

quotes: Removed forced default page sizes to respect each API's native defaults (ZIA: 100, ZPA: 20).

pagination-fix-history.statement: The Python changelog records several ZIA pagination fixes: wrong page parameter names (PR 393), has_next returning True forever on flat-list responses (PR 426), and has_next returning False after the first page on flat-list endpoints (PR 478).

quotes: Fixed ZIA pagination to use correct API parameter names (`page` and `pageSize` instead of `pageNumber`).
Fixed pagination `has_next()` returning `True` for flat list API responses causing infinite loops.
Fixed ZIA pagination where `has_next()` returned `False` after the first page for flat-list endpoints.

n-minus-1-regression.title: Whether list_users and list_groups still drop a record across pages
n-minus-1-regression.detail: Unverified legacy statement: Three upstream issues (#197, #272 and #477) are said to report pagination returning incomplete data, the latest a regression where list_users and list_groups returned N-1 records and has_next returned False early; none is in the vendored tree, and the changelog fix for flat-list endpoints (PR 478) is not tied to them.
n-minus-1-regression.blocks: Whether a bulk list read of users or groups can be trusted without a count check.
